# EndGraphics <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

</div>


```blitzbasic
EndGraphics:Void
```

## Description

Closes the graphics window, which returns the program to the state it had before [Graphics](Graphics): everything that was drawn is gone, and the entities, brushes, textures, images, fonts and movies of the program are freed, as [Graphics](Graphics) without `keep` does (images and fonts stay with `blitzcc --blitzplus`). Use `Graphics` again to open a new window, for example to switch between a window and full screen.

## Differences

* The original opens a new window of the default size, or a console. Here the window is closed and [Print](Print) writes to the console.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Text 10, 10, "Press a key to close the window"
Flip
WaitKey
EndGraphics
Print "The window is closed, this goes to the console"
```
